plan: With a private value of $18, I want to maximize potential profit. Since this is a second-price sealed bid auction, my optimal strategy is to bid close to, but slightly below my true value. Other rational bidders will likely do the same. I'll bid $17.9 - this leaves a small potential profit margin if I win, signals strategic thinking, and prevents overpaying while still having a strong chance of winning.

In a single-round auction with rational opponents, I'll aim to maximize expected profit. My value is $14. A naive strategy would be to bid exactly my value, but sophisticated opponents will anticipate this. I'll bid strategically below my value to create profit margin. Given the $0-$20 uniform distribution, I'll bid around $10-$12 to balance winning probability and potential profit. This signals strategic thinking while maintaining potential earnings.
